assertionAudit.reason: The initial QA assertion unnecessarily required the provider brand name on the deletion page. The actual requirement is that uploaded doctor-test files, persistence and separate verified deletion handling are visibly explained. These concrete conditions are checked below.

visualReview.observed: Saved date/rating, neutral mannequin and selected pain colour are legible at 390 px; Hindi labels and front-view patient right/left are consistent. Fallback shows the selected coarse right-leg region and visible body-area controls. The fixed mobile navigation is present; element screenshots do not certify all scroll positions or physical-device insets.
